title: Indefinite Causal Order from Failure-to-Glue: Contextual Semantics and Parametric Time
summary: Indefinite causal order (ICO) has been studied via higher-order quantum processes (e.g.\ the quantum switch), process matrices, and quantum-gravity proposals involving superposed causal structure, yet the meaning of ``indefiniteness'' and its relation to definite-order explanations often remain opaque.
